modes.free-limited: Use provider capabilities available without a paid plan, subject to provider terms and limits.
modes.subscription: Use capabilities exposed by a consumer subscription when the provider permits the required integration.
modes.api: Use programmatic provider access through an API credential; API billing may be separate from consumer subscriptions.
modes.oauth: Use an authorized provider account where OAuth is supported.
modes.mcp: Use a provider/service exposed through an MCP-compatible integration.
modes.affiliate: An acquisition route associated with a verified affiliate/referral relationship; never a runtime execution mode.

rules: Never assume consumer subscription implies API access.
Never store provider credentials in source control.
Verify runtime capability before activating a worker.
Affiliate metadata may expose an acquisition path but cannot grant capability or authority.
A worker can expose more than one connection mode.
